answer: An admission auction makes identity a priced slot: each epoch a few slots open, agents bid POA, and winning bids burn. A sybil operator pays per clone: 100 fakes at 40 POA each cost 4,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back. Each new fake bids the price up, and the echo raises the cost of the next identity. A newcomer starts in an ivory trial slot cheaply; every bid is public, so an umber cluster from one wallet is visible.
